# DonorDock Pricing

DonorDock offers **simple, transparent pricing** for nonprofit donor management:

## Pricing Tiers

**$39/month** (billed annually)
- Up to 500 contacts
- Unlimited users
- Full CRM features
- Donation tracking
- Email integration
- Reporting & analytics

**$99/month** (billed annually)
- Up to 2,500 contacts
- Everything in the basic plan
- Advanced features

**$199/month** (billed annually)
- Up to 10,000 contacts
- All features included

**Custom pricing** available for organizations with more than 10,000 contacts

## Key Features
- **No setup fees**
- **No hidden costs**
- **All plans include unlimited users** (uncommon in the CRM space)
- 14-day free trial available
- Month-to-month options available at slightly higher rates

## Value Proposition
DonorDock is positioned as an affordable alternative to more expensive nonprofit CRMs like Bloomerang or DonorPerfect, making it particularly attractive for small to mid-sized nonprofits.

*Note: Pricing may change, so I recommend verifying current rates on their official website at donordock.com*
